findings.label: New keywords arrays on previously-undefined consumers
findings.detail: meta.home.keywords and meta.product.keywords did not exist in the base, so the 'keywords: meta.keywords' lines in the four page.js consumers resolved to undefined. The change populates them correctly for both id and en; no consumer change is required. Net improvement, not a regression.

findings.label: Official-store / 100% authentic positioning is an unverifiable business claim
findings.detail: The copy asserts Eksotika Prima is the official store and that products are '100% asli / guaranteed genuine'. This is consistent with the site's own existing ProductList.js detail copy ('Garansi Barang 100% Asli'), but it is a business/legal claim the reviewer cannot independently verify. Recommend the company confirm it reflects actual brand authorization. Non-blocking.
